# property-strategies

> Hypothesis strategies for common data that always satisfy their format: emails, http URLs, semver, JSON values, RFC 3339 datetimes and slugs Python package `trysac-property-strategies`, import name `property_strategies`, MIT licensed,
> Python >= 3.10, no runtime dependencies.
